known_boundaries: Native Mamba cache execution depends on the installed mamba_ssm API; v1.8 safely falls back to bounded recomputation when no compatible incremental API is exposed.
Meta-World and dm_control remain optional adapters and were not runtime-qualified in this container without their external packages.
Distributional critics are a research option, not a claim of benchmark superiority over scalar twin-Q until multi-seed task results demonstrate it.
This release is a research framework and does not claim frontier world-model parity.
major_upgrades: quantile Huber regression with conservative target quantile selection
configurable n-step real replay targets for continuous critics
compute-aware planner-benefit labels and branch-horizon CLI controls
backend-neutral sequence cache with native-cache preference and bounded-recompute fallback
multi-seed environment qualification with per-seed failure reporting
all v1.7 uncertainty calibration, learned arbitration, control, memory, experts, checkpoints and MaleCNS functionality retained
